projectDescription: A Rust crate for building rich, interactive terminal user interfaces (TUIs) with a flexible widget system, layout engine, and multiple backend support.
keyFeatures: Immediate-mode rendering with efficient diff-based terminal updates
Flexible constraint-based layout system (Length, Percentage, Ratio, Fill, Min, Max)
Rich built-in widget library: Block, Paragraph, List, Table, Chart, Canvas, Gauge, Sparkline, Tabs, Scrollbar, Calendar
Multiple backend support: Crossterm (default, cross-platform), Termion (Unix), Termwiz, Termina
Powerful text styling with colors, modifiers (Bold, Italic, Underline, etc.) and the Stylize trait
Modular workspace architecture (ratatui-core, ratatui-widgets, backend crates)
Declarative macros via ratatui-macros for layouts, spans, lines, text, and tables
no_std compatible core crate for embedded and minimalist environments
Serde support for serializing/deserializing style and color types
StatefulWidget trait for widgets that maintain state across frames
publicApiSurface: Constraint::{Length, Percentage, Ratio, Fill, Min, Max}
Block, Paragraph, List, Table, Chart, Canvas, BarChart, Gauge, LineGauge, Sparkline, Tabs, Scrollbar, Calendar
macros: span!, line!, text!, constraints!, vertical!, horizontal!, row!
